submitted_query: I am looking for an existing school building in Turin with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people, to create a spring section (sezione primavera) integrated into an existing kindergarten. Preferably near public transport, and with energy class C or better.
final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type = 'Attività scolastiche'
  AND surface_area >= 180
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D')
  AND mobility >= 71
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: Energy class C or better (A1, A2, A3, A4, B, C). Turin location, 180 sqm minimum floor area, 14-person capacity and public transport proximity are outside the scope of this energy agent and are not filtered here.
User wants the building preferably near public transport. Per the data, 'near' maps to the 75th percentile of mobility (70.93), rounded to 71.

The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 180. The capacity for 14 people is not a floor-area requirement and was not converted into a surface filter. Turin is a city, so it was not mapped to comune_code, and the location, energy class, and public transport preferences are outside the REFERENCE COLUMNS.
